name: Beyond Life and Death
source:
A dice rolling Otome game where you play as Pryce, a girl who has made a deal with the reaper to find love within 48 hours or not she will die -- again. Find love, roll and choose options to gain approval; and get that kiss! Just make sure that Pryce doesn't fumble too much into crying and scare them off.

[Edited from [url=https://giogiogzg.itch.io/beyond-life-and-death]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款掷骰子的乙女游戏，你将扮演Pryce，一个与收割者达成交易的女孩，她将在48小时内找到爱情，否则她将再次死去。寻找爱情，滚动并选择选项以获得认可；并得到那个吻！只要确保普赖斯不会哭得太厉害，把他们吓跑即可。

[编辑自[url=https://giogiogzg.itch.io/beyond-life-and-death]itch.io[/url]]
